metadata.description: PeanutGT's Claude skills — study materials to beautifully laid-out exam-prep PDFs, and more.

plugins.name: exam-prep
plugins.description: Turn slides, textbooks, handwritten-note photos and past exams into exam-prep PDFs: detailed handouts, pattern cards, Cornell recall notes, layered notes, practice questions with verified answers, and cheat sheets. Traditional Chinese by default.

plugins.name: music-studio
plugins.description: Generate instrumental music and BGM locally with ACE-Step 1.5 on an NVIDIA GPU: game loops, video scores, study/work background and personal tracks, with customisable defaults, styles, lexicon and a local dashboard.
